tagline: Regional bank providing comprehensive financial services with total assets of $64.1 billion
hero_kpi_rationale: Valley National Bancorp had total assets of $64.1 billion as of December 31, 2025, an increase of 2.6% compared to 2024, reflecting its financial strength and ability to support a diversified loan portfolio in a complex economic environment.

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company recorded an increase in the allowance for credit losses to $139.7 million in 2025, up from $309.4 million in 2024. Although the provision has decreased, the company remains exposed to credit risk due to loan portfolio exposures and macroeconomic uncertainty.

risks.title: Liquidity Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company has sufficient liquidity with a net loan-to-deposit ratio of 94.4%. However, reliance on customer deposits and potential risks of deposit withdrawals in the event of sector-wide confidence crises remain relevant.

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations in the U.S. banking sector, including enhanced regulatory standards applicable to large insured national banks. Exposure to ongoing regulatory changes creates persistent uncertainty.

risks.title: Competitive Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive regional banking market against large institutions and innovative fintechs. However, the company maintains an established presence with a diversified deposit base.

risks.title: Economic Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly sensitive to macroeconomic conditions, including fluctuations in interest rates, inflation, changes in economic conditions, and geopolitical events. Net interest income and credit quality are directly affected by these factors.

risks.title: Technology and Cybersecurity Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company recognizes the risks related to cyberattacks, ransomware, and information security incidents. The increasing sophistication of attacks targeting the financial services industry creates a persistent threat.

ai_positioning.summary: Valley National Bancorp recognizes the importance of artificial intelligence and related technologies in the financial services industry. The company acknowledges the need to stay current with rapid technological changes including developments relating to artificial intelligence, blockchain, digital currencies, and stablecoins, as well as the ability to effectively assess and monitor the effects and risks associated with the implementation and use of such technology.
evidence: MD&A mentions: 'our ability to stay current with rapid technological changes and evolving legal and regulatory requirements in the financial services industry, including developments relating to the use of artificial intelligence, blockchain, digital currencies, stablecoins, and related regulatory developments'
